about.metaDesc: We're pet parents on a mission to make pet care smarter. Learn about PETLIBRO's story, values, and the team behind our products.
about.intro: We started PETLIBRO because we believed our pets deserved better than plastic bowls and manual scooping. What began as a side project in a Brooklyn apartment has grown into a mission to bring smart, thoughtful technology to pet care — one product at a time.
about.missionText: To empower pet parents with intelligent, beautifully designed products that elevate the everyday experience of caring for the animals we love.
about.value1Desc: Every product starts with the question: how does this make life better for pets? Comfort, safety, and happiness guide every design decision.
about.value2Desc: We harness AI, IoT, and precision engineering to solve real problems — not gimmicks. Technology should simplify pet care, not complicate it.
about.value3Desc: Food-grade stainless steel, BPA-free plastics, and rigorous testing. We use the same products at home with our own pets.
about.value4Desc: From recyclable packaging to energy-efficient devices, we're committed to reducing our environmental footprint with every product we ship.
about.teamDesc: 50+ passionate pet lovers across engineering, design, and customer care
about.timeline2019Desc: Founded in a small apartment by two pet parents frustrated with outdated pet care products. The first prototype: a gravity feeder with a brain.
about.timeline2020Desc: Launched the Granary Smart Feeder on Kickstarter, raising 400% of our goal in 48 hours. Over 5,000 backers believed in our vision.
about.timeline2021Desc: Introduced the Dockstream Smart Fountain and PETLIBRO app, creating a connected ecosystem for modern pet parents.
about.timeline2022Desc: Crossed the milestone of one million pets using PETLIBRO products worldwide. Launched the One RFID Feeder for multi-pet households.
about.timeline2023Desc: Released the Luma Smart Litter Box with Video Cloud AI — our most ambitious product yet, combining self-cleaning with health monitoring.
about.timeline2024Desc: Expanding internationally, deepening our AI health insights, and continuing to build products that pets and their parents love.
about.timeline2025Desc: Grew our catalog to over 50 products, launched the PETLIBRO mobile app with real-time health insights, and introduced same-day delivery in major cities.
about.timeline2026Desc: Continuing to innovate for happy pets everywhere. New AI-powered health monitoring, expanded accessories line, and deeper smart home integrations.

shippingPage.metaDesc: Free shipping on orders over $75. Learn about our shipping methods, delivery times, and tracking options.
shippingPage.heading: Shipping Policy
shippingPage.description: We work hard to get your order to you as quickly as possible. Enjoy free standard shipping on all orders over $75.
shippingPage.freeShippingDesc: All orders totaling $75 or more qualify for free standard shipping within the contiguous United States. No promo code needed — the discount is applied automatically at checkout.
shippingPage.processingText1: Orders are processed within 1-2 business days after payment is confirmed. During high-volume periods such as product launches or holiday seasons, processing may take up to 3 business days.
shippingPage.processingText2: Orders placed after 2 PM EST or on weekends and holidays will begin processing the next business day. You'll receive a confirmation email with your tracking number once your order ships.
shippingPage.trackingText1: Every order includes tracking. Once your order has been shipped, you will receive an email with your tracking number and a link to follow your package in real time.
shippingPage.trackingText2: You can also track your order anytime by visiting our
shippingPage.trackingText3: and entering your order number and email address.
shippingPage.internationalText1: We currently ship to the United States and Canada. Canadian orders are subject to applicable customs duties and taxes, which are the responsibility of the recipient.
shippingPage.internationalText2: International delivery times typically range from 7-14 business days depending on customs processing. We are actively expanding our shipping reach — subscribe to our newsletter for updates.
shippingPage.questionsDesc: Our support team is happy to help with any shipping inquiries.

returnsPage.metaDesc: 30-day hassle-free returns. Learn about our return policy, refund process, and exchanges.
returnsPage.heading: Returns & Refunds
returnsPage.description: We want you and your pets to love every purchase. If something isn't right, our hassle-free return process makes it easy to get a refund or exchange.
returnsPage.windowDesc: You have 30 days from the date of delivery to return most items for a full refund. Items must be in their original condition with all packaging and accessories.
returnsPage.condition1Desc: — Items must include all original parts, manuals, accessories, and packaging.
returnsPage.condition2Desc: — Smart feeders, fountains, and litter boxes must be unopened for a full refund. Opened electronics may be subject to a 15% restocking fee.
returnsPage.condition3Desc: — Items must be free from pet hair, scratches, water damage, or signs of use.
returnsPage.step1Desc: Contact us at support@petlibro.com or visit this page within 30 days of delivery. Include your order number and reason for return.
returnsPage.step2Desc: We'll email you a prepaid return shipping label within 1 business day. Print it and attach it to your package.
returnsPage.step3Desc: Pack the item securely in its original packaging with all accessories included. Drop it off at any authorized shipping location.
returnsPage.step4Desc: Once we receive and inspect the return, your refund will be processed within 5-7 business days to your original payment method.
returnsPage.exchangesText1: Want a different size, color, or product? We're happy to process an exchange. When contacting our team, let us know what you'd like instead and we'll handle the rest.
returnsPage.exchangesText2: If the replacement item costs more, we'll charge the difference. If it costs less, we'll refund the balance. Exchange shipments are sent via standard shipping at no extra cost.
returnsPage.nonReturnableDesc: For hygiene and safety reasons, the following items cannot be returned or exchanged:
nonReturnableItems: Used litter box liners and waste bags
Opened filter packs and consumable accessories
returnsPage.ctaDesc: Our team will guide you through every step of the process.

warrantyPage.metaDesc: PETLIBRO warranty coverage details. 1-year warranty on electronics and 6-month warranty on accessories.
warrantyPage.heading: Warranty Policy
warrantyPage.description: Every PETLIBRO product is built to last. We stand behind the quality of our products with comprehensive warranty coverage.
coveredItems: Motor or pump failure not caused by misuse
Software bugs affecting core device function
notCoveredItems: Damage from misuse, abuse, or unauthorized modification
Normal wear and tear including scratches and cosmetic damage
Damage caused by pets chewing, scratching, or knocking over the product
Consumable parts such as filters, desiccant pads, and liners
warrantyPage.claim1Desc: Have your order number, product serial number, and a brief description of the issue ready. Photos or a short video of the defect are helpful.
warrantyPage.claim2Desc: Email warranty@petlibro.com or reach out through our Contact page. Our team typically responds within 1 business day.
warrantyPage.claim3Desc: Our team may walk you through troubleshooting steps. If the issue is confirmed as a warranty defect, we'll arrange a replacement or repair at no cost to you.
warrantyPage.claim4Desc: Approved claims are fulfilled within 5-10 business days. We cover return shipping for defective products within the warranty period.
warrantyPage.ctaTitle: Need to file a warranty claim?
warrantyPage.ctaDesc: Our warranty team is here to help resolve any product issues quickly.
